entries.name: vbWBTC
entries.description: This token contract uses a standard 'vault bridge token' implementation created by Agglayer CDK. It keeps deposited assets in a vault and issues an IOU token (Vault Bridge WBTC) which can be deposited to Agglayer. The underlying asset is generating yield, which does not accrue to the vbWBTC-IOU but is sent to eth:0x261a25ec6c396389B75B6b22BD4A8227070E3B50.

entries.name: MigrationManager
entries.description: Helper contract for the vaultBridge tokens on Layer 2. If any vbTokens are minted 'natively' on Layer 2, this contract can receive the underlying assets and lock them in the Layer 1 vaults.
